title: listrostachys wittmackii
intro: Listrostachys wittmackii, commonly known as the Bolivian mint or Andean mint, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal and culinary purposes, providing several health benefits, including digestive relief, antioxidant properties, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant's leaves and stems have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as reducing stress, improving digestion, and aiding in the management of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Listrostachys wittmackii include rosmarinic acid, ursolic acid, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
